current_note: COURT + ROADMAP DONE: 55 SHIP / 6 DOWNGRADE / 9 PARK across 70 features, 8 epics, all 10 open questions settled. Key rulings, all of which bind the build: the push/active_day threshold of 15 is FLAG-FOR-REVIEW ONLY and never an auto-exclude, because the driver's validation showed the distribution is continuous rather than gapped - every exclusion becomes a recorded human denylist verdict. NO COMPOSITE SCORE ANYWHERE (F029 beat F028): admission is three independent floors and the index sorts by facets, so it is a directory and not a league table, which matches the owner's ethics choice. REST contributor fan-out beat GH-Archive co-pushers on measured evidence (2.4 calls/repo and correct attribution vs 1.5-22.6% recall with merge-bot noise). Stargazer enumeration was rejected on cost - roughly 35,600 API calls for the top 20 repos alone - leaving only a capped post-launch experiment. The hard pair was settled by SHAPE not rate: Dicklesworthstone is self-repo mass push, diegosouzapw is fork-farm basename concentration, both denylisted day one. A LIVE PRIVACY FINDING emerged: crackscan already emits Signals for merely-CONSIDERED candidates, so names can reach the public vault today without ever being admitted. The opt-out is therefore gated at crackscan.fetch() itself as well as at the site, and F067 tests both layers. The Court's stated biggest risk is honest: the automation boundary is continuous, so safety rests on shape heuristics plus a human review loop rather than a mechanical threshold, and a novel automation shape below 15 push/day that avoids the known fingerprints could reach a published profile beside real named people. E01 NOW BUILDING (wf_f4e3675d-f92) - the risk-first sanity spike. Its whole purpose is the launch-blocking F066 gate: produce a real ranked top-20 from the vault lane over the real corpus and justify every one of the 20 individually. If it contains a single bot, service account or mass-repo spammer, the epic has failed and nothing downstream ships.
